messages:
Laura: quick proposal: lease-based GC for on-prem artifact stores + signed tombstone provenance for evicted blobs.
Laura: motivation: air-gapped clusters accumulate many bundle/image revisions and run out of disk; need safe eviction while preserving audit provenance.
Raj: eviction triggers? per-component retention_count vs global TTL?
Laura: combo: per-component retention_count + global TTL. Eviction writes a signed tombstone JSON that records artifact id, evicted_at, reason, signer, and a compact proof_anchor.
Tim: agent resume concern: missing blobs during resume?
Laura: agent checks tombstone index: if tombstoned -> resumable=false + operator guidance; if not tombstoned -> hard error.
Maya: audits need signing root + activation epoch in tombstone. Also expose tombstone as OCI annotation (com.redwood.tombstone=1) for registry compatibility.
Raj: perf: global index scan expensive. Propose sharded local tombstone indexes with local lease TTL (default 30d) and coordinated compaction window; eviction requires lease expiry + cluster quorum.
Tim: rollback path?
Laura: two recovery flows: operator-approved rehydrate from archival seed, or fastpull from peers if blobs still present and leases not fully expired.
Maya: emit artifact.evicted events to audit stream and keep audit retention longer than content TTL.
Laura: action items: RFC + schema (this week); Raj: index sharding design; Maya: KMS signing policy; Tim: rehydrate runbook.
OperatorBot: created issue RW-eviction-2026 -> https://go/repo/RW-eviction-2026
Tim: will move discussion to the RFC PR, closing thread to reduce noise.
